nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
Mapping of token balances per address used by transfer, transferFrom and balance mutation.
Total token supply, mutated by issue, redeem, destroyBlackFunds and the constructor.
Transfer fee rate expressed in basis points, configurable by CEO via setFeeParams.
Maximum fee cap for transfers, configurable by CEO via setFeeParams.
Address that receives collected fees and minted assets; changed by transferAssetOwner.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances used by transferFrom and approval methods.
Emergency stop flag toggled by pause/unpause.
Blacklist mapping; blacklisted addresses cannot transfer and can be destroyed.
Mapping of method name to MethodParam storing two-phase submit/confirm data.
Address of the upgraded contract that receives forwarded ERC20 calls when deprecated.
Flag indicating whether the legacy contract forwards calls to the upgraded contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization, allowance and balance accounting.
Ownable function that transfers contract ownership to a new address; guarded by onlyOwner.
BasicToken.transfer: computes fee, debits sender, credits recipient and assetOwner.
StandardToken.transferFrom: allowance-based transfer with fee deduction and allowance update.
StandardToken.approve: sets allowance of a spender on behalf of msg.sender.
StandardToken.increaseApproval: increases an existing allowance using SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval: decreases allowance, zeroing it if the subtracted value exceeds it.
BlackListToken.addBlackList: adds an address to the blacklist; guarded by onlyCRO.
BlackListToken.removeBlackList: removes an address from the blacklist; guarded by onlyCRO.
BlackListToken.destroyBlackFunds: burns blacklisted balances and reduces totalSupply_; guarded by onlyCEO.
TwoPhaseToken.submitIssue: manager submits an issue amount into params for later confirmation.
TwoPhaseToken.comfirmIsses: reviewer confirms and mints tokens using the stored manager value.
TwoPhaseToken.submitRedeem: manager submits a redeem amount into params for later confirmation.
TwoPhaseToken.comfirmRedeem: reviewer confirms and burns tokens from assetOwner.
Pausable.pause: CEO sets paused to true to stop token operations.
Pausable.unpause: CEO sets paused to false to resume token operations.
RBAC.addRole: internal role grant writing into the roles mapping and emitting RoleAdded.
RBAC.removeRole: internal role revocation writing into the roles mapping and emitting RoleRemoved.
WitToken.transfer: validates destination and blacklist, forwards to upgraded contract if deprecated.
WitToken.transferFrom: validates destination and blacklists, forwards to upgraded contract if deprecated.
WitToken.deprecate: sets deprecated and upgradedAddress; guarded by onlyCEO and whenPaused.
WitToken.setFeeParams: CEO sets basisPointsRate and maximumFee (scaled by decimals).
WitToken.transferAssetOwner: CEO changes the fee/mint beneficiary address.
WitToken constructor: initializes supply, balances, assetOwner and fee parameters.
Unsafe multiplication/division/subtraction computing the transfer fee from basisPointsRate.
Unsafe add/sub arithmetic mutating balances and totalSupply_ during transfers, minting, burning and redemption.
External call delegation to the UpgradedStandardToken contract when the token is deprecated.
Unsafe multiplication of newMaxFee by 10**decimals when setting fee parameters.
Unsafe subtraction/write of the allowed mapping inside transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter used for transfers, approvals and two-phase submissions.
Computed transfer fee derived from the basis points rate and capped by maximumFee.
Amount actually credited to the recipient after deducting the fee.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval.
Amount added to an allowance in increaseApproval.
Amount subtracted from an allowance in decreaseApproval.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Address parameter of RBAC role add/remove helpers.
Role name string parameter used as key into the roles mapping.
Address whose funds are destroyed in destroyBlackFunds.
Address added to the blacklist.
Address removed from the blacklist.
Local variable holding the balance of a blacklisted account before burning.
Address of the upgraded contract passed to deprecate.
New fee rate in basis points passed to setFeeParams.
New maximum fee passed to setFeeParams before decimal scaling.
New beneficiary address passed to transferAssetOwner.
Local variable caching the current allowance in decreaseApproval.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the debited balance holder in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender key in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry written by approve.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry incremented by increaseApproval.
msg.sender owns the allowance entry decreased by decreaseApproval.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyCRO role check gates addBlackList on msg.sender.
onlyCEO role check gates pause on msg.sender.
onlyCEO check gates deprecate on msg.sender.
onlyCEO check gates setFeeParams on msg.sender.
onlyCEO check gates transferAssetOwner on msg.sender.
Recipient parameter _to flows into transfer balance crediting.
Amount parameter _value drives the debit and fee computation in transfer.
Sender balance from the balances mapping is read and updated by transfer.
transfer invokes fee arithmetic mul/div/sub that can mis-handle rounding and overflow.
basisPointsRate is multiplied with the transfer value in the fee arithmetic.
_value is the multiplicand in the fee multiplication.
Fee arithmetic produces the local fee variable.
maximumFee caps the computed fee.
sendAmount is derived by subtracting fee from _value.
transfer performs add/sub on balances and totalSupply state.
Computed fee is added to the assetOwner balance entry.
Unsafe arithmetic writes the updated balances mapping.
Unsafe supply arithmetic mutates totalSupply_ during mint/burn operations.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance inside the supply/balance arithmetic.
destroyBlackFunds uses sub arithmetic on totalSupply_ when burning balances.
dirtyFunds is the subtrahend applied to totalSupply_.
comfirmIsses adds the confirmed amount to balances and totalSupply_.
comfirmRedeem subtracts the confirmed amount from balances and totalSupply_.
transferFrom mutates balances with SafeMath add/sub after fee deduction.
Source parameter _from indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
transferFrom updates the allowance via the allowance update operation.
Existing allowance is read from the allowed mapping in transferFrom.
Allowance update writes the reduced value back into the allowed mapping.
_value is subtracted from the spender allowance in the allowance update.
_spender keys the allowance written by approve.
_spender keys the allowance incremented by increaseApproval.
_spender keys the allowance decreased by decreaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the current allowance.
_subtractedValue is subtracted from the cached allowance.
decreaseApproval caches the current allowance in oldValue.
oldValue is compared and subtracted, driving the branch that can underflow.
_evilUser is the address flagged in the blacklist mapping.
addBlackList writes the isBlackListed mapping.
addBlackList sets isBlackListed[_evilUser] to true.
_clearedUser is the address unflagged in the blacklist mapping.
removeBlackList clears the isBlackListed entry.
_blackListedUser selects the balance destroyed by destroyBlackFunds.
destroyBlackFunds requires the target address to be blacklisted.
destroyBlackFunds reads the target balance into dirtyFunds.
addr is the grantee in the internal addRole helper.
roleName keys the roles mapping in addRole.
addr is the revoked address in removeRole.
roleName keys the roles mapping in removeRole.
_upgradedAddress is stored by deprecate before forwarding calls.
deprecate writes the upgradedAddress state variable.
deprecate sets the deprecated flag to true.
WitToken.transfer delegates to the upgraded contract, an external call that can re-enter before state settles.
WitToken.transferFrom delegates to the upgraded contract through an external call.
deprecated flag selects the forwarding branch in WitToken.transfer.
deprecated flag selects the forwarding branch in WitToken.transferFrom.
upgradedAddress is the target of the external delegation call.
newBasisPoints is stored into basisPointsRate by setFeeParams.
newMaxFee is scaled and stored by setFeeParams.
newMaxFee is multiplied by 10**decimals in the fee parameter arithmetic.
setFeeParams performs the multiplication that can overflow.
setFeeParams writes the basisPointsRate state variable.
The scaled result is stored into maximumFee.
newAssetOwner is the new beneficiary assigned by transferAssetOwner.
transferAssetOwner writes the assetOwner state variable.
newOwner is assigned to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership reads the current owner for the ownership check and event.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
unpause sets the paused flag to false.
whenNotPaused modifier reads the paused flag to gate WitToken.transfer.
WitToken constructor initializes totalSupply_.
WitToken constructor credits the initial balances mapping.
WitToken constructor sets assetOwner to the deployer.
comfirmIsses reads the stored value and state from params.
comfirmRedeem reads the stored value and state from params.
submitIssue writes the manager-provided value into params.
submitRedeem writes the manager-provided value into params.
_value submitted by the manager is stored for later confirmation.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a value parameter only consumed by the transfer/transferFrom balance crediting logic.
_value is the transfer amount whose arithmetic is the core sink inside transfer.
fee is the direct arithmetic result of the fee computation unsafe operation.
sendAmount is produced by the subtraction feeding the balance mutation arithmetic.
_from is the source address parameter only used by transferFrom.
_spender is the spender key parameter consumed by the approval methods.
_addedValue is the increment parameter of increaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is the decrement parameter of decreaseApproval.
newOwner is the sole parameter assigned to the owner state variable.
addr is the grantee/revokee address parameter of the RBAC role helpers.
roleName is the mapping key parameter of the RBAC role helpers.
_blackListedUser selects the balance burnt by destroyBlackFunds.
_evilUser is the address parameter written by addBlackList.
_clearedUser is the address parameter cleared by removeBlackList.
dirtyFunds is the temporary balance value subtracted from totalSupply_.
_upgradedAddress is the parameter stored into upgradedAddress by deprecate.
newBasisPoints is the fee rate parameter stored by setFeeParams.
newMaxFee is the ceiling parameter scaled and stored by setFeeParams.
newAssetOwner is the beneficiary parameter assigned to assetOwner.
oldValue is the cached allowance local variable of decreaseApproval.
